name: Vitko Runners, recommended configuration (warm starts + split tests)

workflow_input.split: true on workloads with a splittable test step

note: Warm starts: vitko-inc/checkpoint after the setup steps, captured from a run on the default branch; measured runs come from another branch. Split tests: vitko-inc/split-tests on the splittable test steps (unit tests, and vite's three end-to-end steps), with spec files that need the outside network in a separate unsplit step. Only the parts are billed while a split step runs.
